resources.string: Reading PS5 subtitles and translating them into Turkish
PS5 is in another Remote Play session. Close the other device.
PS5 not found on the network. Are the phone and PS5 on the same network?
PS5 did not wake from rest mode.
The PS5 asks for this account\'s login passcode. Enter it in Settings, or turn off this account\'s login passcode on the PS5.
The PS5 didn\'t accept the login passcode in Settings. Correct it, or turn off this account\'s login passcode on the PS5.
PS5 refused the connection. Pair again.
Sign in to PSN and pair your PS5 first.
The Remote Play library could not be loaded on this device.
The subtitle server could not start (port 8787 is in use).
Translation is unavailable right now; retrying.
The free translation model could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection.
In games without Turkish, your phone reads the English subtitles and translates them into Turkish. You play as usual.
All the text of popular games is already translated, for free. Subtitles arrive instantly, without internet. Other games use free translation.
Show subtitles on the TV over the game, or in large type on your phone. Setup takes a few minutes.
The phone connects to your PS5 with Remote Play. Sign in with a free second PSN account, separate from the one you play with.
If the page doesn\'t appear, you can sign in in your browser below.
You can try again, or sign in in your phone\'s browser and paste the address here.

Sign in with your second account in the browser that opens. When you finish, the browser goes to a page starting with remoteplay.dl.playstation.net (it may be blank or an error page). Copy that page\'s address from the address bar, paste it here and tap Next.
This address has no sign-in code. It should start with https://remoteplay.dl.playstation.net/remoteplay/redirect?code=
Couldn\'t reach the internet or Sony. Check your connection.
The page took too long to open.
Couldn\'t make a secure connection (are the date and time right?).
The page stayed blank; Sony\'s sign-in app didn\'t run in this phone\'s in-app browser.
The in-app browser (Android System WebView) didn\'t work. Try updating it from the Play Store.
Something went wrong while loading the page.
On the PS5, with the second account, choose Settings › System › Remote Play › Pair Device and enter the code shown.
On the TV, over the game
The CouchSubs TV app finds this phone by itself when opened. To install the TV app the first time, use CouchSubs on a computer once.
No TV seen on the network (it may be off; that\'s fine).
Tap after opening the game on your PS5. The phone receives the picture, reads the subtitles and translates them.
On the TV over the game, or on this phone. Tap to change.
In supported games, pre-translated subtitles arrive instantly. Free.
Your devices, PSN account, notifications and translation engine are here.
No packs found. While online, tap Update packs.
Keep the PS5, TV and phone on the same network
With your own account, on the TV

When Remote Play connects with the same account, it takes over your session and controller. The second account only receives the picture; you keep playing with your own account and controller. The account is free, no PS Plus needed.
The code is valid for 5 minutes. If something fails, the reason appears here.
The PS5 did not recognize this PSN account. Make sure you took the code from the screen opened with the second account.
Code not accepted. Enter the new code from the PS5.
The PS5 is in another Remote Play session right now.
The PS5 system software is not compatible with this version. Update the PS5.
Remote Play stopped on the PS5. Restart the PS5 and try again.
This address could not be resolved. Check the PS5\'s IP address.
The PS5 did not respond. Are the phone and PS5 on the same Wi-Fi?
The PS5 received the code but did not respond. Try again.
You can change this later from the home screen.
Looking for TVs on the network…
No TV, or the TV app isn\'t installed
Open the game on your PS5, then start.
You can already browse the packs and settings.
To connect to your PS5, pair it in Settings.
GTA V, RDR2, Mafia and more
Screen stays on · brightness dims automatically
The pack is chosen automatically when the game opens. Lines not in the pack are translated with your chosen engine. Packs are free; new ones and fixes download automatically.
New packs and fixes download automatically once a week
In games with a ready pack, this engine only translates missing lines.
Only needed if the second account has a login passcode on the PS5. CouchSubs enters it when the PS5 asks; it is stored encrypted on the phone.
When off, all lines are translated with your chosen engine.
CouchSubs has no accounts: your settings stay only on this phone. The app and game packs are free.
Install the TV app from this phone
No computer needed. Samsung and Android TV (Google TV); barely tested on real TVs yet.
Install the TV app from this phone (experimental)
Installs the CouchSubs TV app on your Samsung TV from this phone, without a computer. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Experimental: Samsung TVs and smart monitors (2017 and later). LG still needs a computer for now.
No Samsung TV found. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? You can also type its address below (on the TV: Settings › General › Network › Network Status).
Host PC IP belongs to another device: %1$s
Turn on developer mode on the TV
2. Press 1 2 3 4 5 on the remote (or type 12345 on the on-screen keypad). The Developer mode window opens. On some new models this works on Apps › App Settings.
3. Turn Developer mode On, type this phone\'s address as Host PC IP and press OK:
4. Restart the TV: hold the power button on the remote for about 2 seconds until the TV turns off, then turn it on again. A short press only puts it on standby.
Could not find this phone\'s address; is it on Wi-Fi?

The first install asks you to sign in once with a free Samsung account: Samsung only accepts the app signed with a certificate made for your TV. If the phone\'s address changes, repeat the Host PC IP step.
Getting a certificate for your TV from Samsung…
Installing on the TV… (this can take a minute)
Removing the old copy from the TV…
Opening the app on the TV…
Installed: CouchSubs %1$s is opening on the TV.
CouchSubs %1$s is already on the TV; opening it.
If the TV shows “Server under maintenance”, it cannot reach Samsung\'s servers: check the TV\'s internet connection and its date and time, restart the TV and try again.
The TV did not accept this phone. In the TV\'s Developer mode window, check that Host PC IP is this phone\'s address (%1$s), then restart the TV (hold the power button for about 2 seconds).
This Samsung TV is too old for the CouchSubs TV app (2017 models and later are supported).
Samsung sign-in did not complete. Try again and finish signing in on the page that opens.
Samsung did not issue the signing certificate. Try again in a few minutes.
The TV is out of free space. Remove an app you do not use from the TV and try again.
A CouchSubs TV app signed on another device is still on the TV and could not be removed. On the TV, open Apps, select CouchSubs, delete it and try again.

The TV did not accept the signing certificate. Make sure the TV is connected to the internet (it checks the certificate with Samsung) and its date and time are right (Settings › General › System Manager › Time), then try again. CouchSubs gets a new certificate, so you sign in to Samsung once more.
The TV\'s clock is behind, so the new certificate is not valid for it yet. Set the TV\'s date and time (Settings › General › System Manager › Time) or wait a few minutes, then try again.

The TV refuses CouchSubs because an earlier CouchSubs is still registered on it (Tizen error 118, -22), even if it no longer appears among the apps. If CouchSubs is among the TV\'s apps, delete it there and try again. Otherwise reset Smart Hub (Settings › Support › Device Care › Self Diagnosis › Reset Smart Hub) and try again. Resetting Smart Hub also removes the other apps you downloaded.
The connection to the TV dropped during the install. Keep the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone, keep the phone\'s screen on, then try again.
The TV app could not be installed. Try again; if it fails again, send us the install log.
This phone app does not contain the TV package. Update the app and try again.
On the TV, answer Allow to “Allow USB debugging?” (tick “Always allow from this device”).
Getting the developer key from the TV…
Installs the CouchSubs Android TV app on your Android TV or Google TV from this phone, without a computer. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Experimental: debugging must be on in the TV\'s developer options. You can turn it off after the install.
No Android TV found. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? You can also type its address below (on the TV: Settings › Network & Internet › the connected network).
IP address and port in the pairing window
Pairing code (6 digits; leave empty if already paired)
With wireless debugging, type the TV\'s port too: the “IP address & Port” at the top of the TV\'s Wireless debugging screen (e.g. 192.168.1.20:41235).
Next to the pairing code, type the IP address and port from the pairing window too (e.g. 192.168.1.20:37099).
Turn on debugging on the TV
1. Turn on developer options: on the TV, open Settings › System (or Device Preferences) › About and press the Android TV OS build row 7 times.
2. In Settings › System › Developer options, turn on USB debugging. Some TVs also have “Network debugging” or “ADB over network”; turn that on too.

3. Press Install and open. When the TV asks “Allow USB debugging?”, tick “Always allow from this device” and choose Allow. If it cannot connect, try the Wireless debugging option (Android 11 and later, Google TV).
2. Turn on Developer options › Wireless debugging and open it. Type the “IP address & Port” at the top as the TV\'s address.
3. The first time, press “Pair device with pairing code”; type the IP address and port from that window together with the 6-digit code, and press Install and open while the window is still open.
Remove the TV\'s copy and install

The TV did not respond. Make sure the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone, and that debugging is on in its developer options. With wireless debugging the port changes every time; type the one on the screen.
Debugging was not allowed on the TV. Try again and choose Allow on the TV.
The TV does not know this phone. With wireless debugging, pair first: press “Pair device with pairing code” on the TV, type the address and the code from that window and try again.
Pairing failed: the code is wrong or the pairing window on the TV closed. Open the window again, type the new code and port and try again.

CouchSubs on the TV was installed from Google Play. Play signs it with a different key, so this version cannot be installed over it. You can keep using the Play version; to install this one (with overlay mode), the button below removes the TV\'s copy and installs the new one. The TV app\'s settings are deleted.

CouchSubs on the TV is signed with another key or is newer, so this version cannot be installed over it. The button below removes the TV\'s copy and installs the new one. The TV app\'s settings are deleted.
